versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Com_02087 If the configured ComSignalDataInvalidValue is received for at least one group signal of a signal group and the ComDataInvalidAction is configured to REPLACE for this signal group, the AUTOSAR COM module shall replace all group signals of this signal group by their configured ComSignalInitValue values. After the replace- ment, the normal signal group / group signal processing like reception notification shall 47 of 259 Document ID 15: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_COM Specification of Communication AUTOSAR CP R25-11 take place as if the ComSignalInitValue would have been received for all group signals.
